text:
sam: FYI: ops flagged several tenants with sudden quota burn increases but we can't find matching request volume in the backend. Anyone else seeing this?

maya: Yup, spotted it on staging dashboards. The numbers jump for quota buckets but api-gateway logs are flat.

ryan: My hunchis attribution duplication somewhere in the telemetry path. Possible culprits: SDK header duplication on retry or proxy header merging.

akiko: I pulled raw events and found repeated route hints in the same event envelope. Example snippet:
```
Event.meta: {
  "x-request-id": "req-7f3",
  "x-route-hint": "tenant=blueco;quota=standard",
  "x-route-hint": "tenant=blueco;quota=standard"
}
```
If the event publisher doesn't collapse multiple headers, downstream counts double.

sam: Confirmed from py-sdk: v0.14.2's retry decorator was appending to x-route-hint instead of replacing when re-sending. The code does `headers.setdefault('x-route-hint', [])` then `.append(...)`.

jen: Is this isolated to Python? We should triage TS/Go quickly.

maya: Quick grep: TS client sets header atomically, Go has a proxy-path where upstream+downstream headers are merged and could produce duplicates if upstream already included it.

ryan: So two orthogonal bugs: client-side append on retry (py) and proxy merge behavior (go path). Mitigation plan: fix py fast, add short-term ingestion dedupe, then harden proxies.

akiko: Proposed steps: 1) Py fix: replace header on retry and publish a patch. 2) Ingestion: add a temporary dedupe stage keyed by (request_id, normalized-route-hint) with a 5s sliding window. 3) Proxy: add normalization/merge policy to avoid duplicate header entries. 4) Add telemetry integration test covering retry flows.

sam: I can open a py-sdk PR now with minimal change: set header to string value rather than list append.

ops-bot: @sam opened py-sdk PR 417: https://git.redwood/sam/py-sdk/pull/417 (emergency patch). CI queued.

jen: Product ok with defensive dedupe temporarily, but requests an indicator in the console that "attribution dedupe active" so customers know we adjusted counts. Also add an audit event when dedupe modifies counts.

maya: For the ingestion dedupe, I'm going to deploy a short-lived lambda into the staging pipeline with a 5s state window. ops-bot, can you instrument alerts to ignore dedupe-induced count drops for staging tenants?

ops-bot: Deployed staging dedupe lambda (5s window). Suppressing quota spike alerts for test tenants. Will schedule prod rollout after sign-off.

ryan: Also adding a normalization function for route-hint strings: trim whitespace, lower-case keys and sort k/v pairs before hashing. That should prevent casing/spacing differences from bypassing dedupe.

akiko: Good call. I'll coordinate a proxy config change to avoid concatenating identical headers; instead prefer server-side replacement or single canonical header.

sam: Timeline suggestion: PR merged -> canary py release in 3h -> confirm metrics -> prod release. Ingestion dedupe to go to prod as a short-term patch within 1h after code review.

maya: I ran basic smoke on staging with a synthetic retry flood and confirmed the py patch removes duplicate headers and staging quota graph returns to baseline.

jen: Post-deploy UX: show small banner on quota chart "Attribution dedupe active (temporary)" and include link to incident note. Also add an audit event for customers so they can reconcile. Approved.

ryan: I'll own ingestion tests. Plan to add a replay test that generates a retry chain and asserts a single attribution in the console tally. Also include a test for normalization logic.

akiko: After mitigation, we'll run a retro and capture root cause: SDK retry append bug + proxy merge behavior. We'll add a checklist to SDK release process to include header idempotency tests.

sam: Linking PR and follow-ups in case notes: https://git.redwood/sam/py-sdk/pull/417 , https://git.redwood/platform/ingestion/pull/902 (dedupe stage).

maya: Can we also add an internal lint that flags code paths that append the same header key type more than once? Might catch future regressions.

jen: Good idea. Add it to devex CI.

ops-bot: Prod dedupe scheduled in 45m for a 30m smoke. Alerts adjusted.

sam: Thanks all. Will keep thread pinned until postmortem published. Please paste any repro snippets or traces into the PRs. :white_check_mark:
